profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MAG Aerospace
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Software Engineer skilled in U.S. Department of Defense, software development, management, customer service, and strategic planning. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Data Management, Software Engineering and Network Security from Park University. 

Broad skilled, critical-thinker, software developer and security analyst. Proven ability to lead software development teams with a variety of software methodologies. Translate system specifications and requirements into program code and database structures and implements design functionality. Analyze output of products and debugs source code to isolate and correct errors in program logic, syntax, and data entry and to ensure accuracy.

Key Skills include:

•	Client/Server Side Software Development
•	Software Testing/validation
•	Agile and Waterfall Methodologies
•	Interfacing with customers
•	Program/Project Management
•	C#, Java, JavaScript, HTML
•	Oracle and SQL
•	Troubleshooting skills
•	Deployment of Software
•	Oral and written communication skills
•	Coding Standards
•	Angular, Material, Bootstrap

email: anthony.inauen@outlook.com
phone: 405-537-0927

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
- Design multiple apps using C#, Javascript, XCode, Kotlin, Xamarin languages
- Design Network scripts
- Use Python to create desktop apps for linux and windows
- Design asp.net React.js web app
- Use Azure for repo, deployment and web publishing
- Azure Media Services
- Azure SQL database
- Maintenance and creating new features on Meteor app, using javascript, Mongodb, bootstrap and Meteor libraries.
- Docker and Azure K8

company.name: ARMA Global Corporation, A General Dynamics Company

positions.title: NCOIC Technology Integration, Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed Software, Developing Training Plans, Managing Programmers, Testing Software Releases, Administer Learning Management System
•	Supervised system access for 556 faculty, 587 Department of Defense test administrators and 41,900 students
•	Coordinated and led System testing between three military agencies to provide enrollment capabilities to 20,000 students
•	Analyzed new military education software to be compliance to STIG and AFNIC certification.
•	Designed multiple database queries and managed database.
•	Created Web Application to keep track of individual military students, enabling instructors to keep accountability.

positions.title: Supervisor of Software Development Team
positions.description:
•	Led 5 member team through multiple iterations of software releases from initial to final release
•	Managed 36 software reviews between developers and customers
•	Analyzed military documents and identified 125 discrepancies in relations to released code.
•	Provided war gaming tech support to 3 Air University and 2 international schools
•	Ensured all milestones are met through software lifecycle management to ensure on-time release of new war gaming software 
•	Designed multiple program application enhancements using C#, HTML and JavaScript

positions.title: Manager, Airborne early Warning and Control System Software Development
positions.description:
•	Led 4 member design team and developed 38 requirements to correct 58 software errors
•	Managed 30 member software development shop which provided support and updates for 1.2 million lines of code and ensure software security of a 9.6 billion dollar system
•	Led team to contribute to 67 enhancements on one release which turned out to be the largest Airborne Early Warning and Control system release in history
